fullDesc: On March 23, 2021 the container ship Ever Given ran aground and blocked the Suez Canal for six days. Hundreds of ships waited, and the jam showed how fragile global shipping can be.
realFacts: About 12 percent of world trade passes through the canal
Tugboats and dredgers freed the ship on March 29
Costs ran into billions of dollars per day of delay
The owners and canal authority settled in 2021
